_doc: Shared vectors for swarm/redact.py redact_text (tests/test_redact.py) and omp/src/swarm_bar.ts redactText (omp/test/swarm_bar.test.ts). A string or list of strings (joined with '') is used for input, must_not_contain and must_contain, so no secret-shaped literal sits in the repo; a long random secret is a placeholder `{{tok:KIND:INDEX:LENGTH}}` (kinds jwt, urlsafe) that tests/test_redact.py and omp/test/swarm_bar.test.ts expand at runtime with the algorithm documented in tests/fixtures/redact_generated.json `_doc`. Output must contain no must_not_contain substring and every must_contain substring. When `expected` is present the whole output must equal it exactly (every vector is also a fixed point: redacting the output changes nothing).
